purpose: Prioritize R1b reconnaissance without using reproductive effect direction, while preserving the distinction between occurrence evidence and experimental admission.
ranking_inputs_allowed: source-backed current or historical occurrence locality
geographic independence from the focal context
whether an exact population/site can be resolved before outcomes
phenological overlap with the planned measurement protocol
ability to instantiate independent site-time exposure blocks
ranking_inputs_forbidden: mature seed or fruit response direction
choosing a site because it produces the expected crossover
retrofitting a transport site after focal outcomes are known

focal_Campanula_priority.decision: Use Oshima for first reconnaissance because multiple independent sources already resolve named localities; do not treat any locality as admitted until plant abundance, block independence, SVD/treatment feasibility, access, permits and phenology pass the R1b audit.
Resolve an exact current Campanula population before assigning confirmatory blocks; the current herbarium evidence is island-level and cannot close R1b by itself.

transport_Farfugium_priority.decision: Primary transport reconnaissance candidate because it supplies a second geography and an official locality lead while remaining outcome-blind; experimental access, abundance, permit status and block structure remain pending.

Backup transport candidates only. Same-island transport is biologically broader through taxon/season but geographically weaker than Kozushima and therefore should not displace the Kozushima candidate merely for convenience.

oshima_senzu_coastal.basis: The Oshima coastal plant community is designated as a natural monument; occurrence evidence is valuable, but manipulative work must not be assumed permissible.
oshima_senzu_coastal.admission_rule: permit_status must be confirmed or not_required under the competent authority before any row can be admitted

national_park_general.basis: National-park special areas can require permission for regulated plant-related actions; this lock does not infer that every candidate site or every planned manipulation is prohibited.
national_park_general.admission_rule: resolve the exact protected-area category and planned actions during R1b before admission

current_decision: R1b remains open. The next information gain is field/permit reconnaissance at named candidate localities, not additional literature hunting or outcome analysis.
claim_boundary: This priority lock ranks reconnaissance candidates only. It is not proof of current abundance, experimental feasibility, legal permission, independent-block count, H5 power, or natural validation of the synthetic mechanism.
